name: copy-buttons
description: Copy buttons on each final reply's closing line: the reply as markdown or rendered, each code block, and tables as spreadsheet rows

icon.title: Icon style
icon.description: Icon before each copy action. standard: ⧉ (any font). nerd-font: 󰆏 (needs a Nerd Font; pick it only if this icon shows here)

replyFormat.title: Copy reply as
replyFormat.description: What the Reply action copies first. markdown: the reply as Claude wrote it. rendered: laid out as the terminal shows it, without its line wrapping. Pressing Reply again while it shows ✓ copies the other.

blockHover.title: Code block hover
blockHover.description: How a code block is marked while the pointer is over it, its copy button shown at its top right. highlight: the block on a grey card. bar: a bar at its left. off: no hover; each block's button stays at the end of the answer (for a terminal that reports no pointer motion).

copiedNotice.title: Copied notice
copiedNotice.description: Where "copied" is shown after a copy. above-button: a line above the pressed button ("copied 5 lines"). toast: a small box at the top right. above-prompt: a line above the prompt, at its right.
